title: Migrate config to JSON, update app.py, and add unit tests
desc: Write migrate_config.py (reads config.ini and writes config.json with keys host, port:int, db_url, debug:bool; must not overwrite existing config.json). Update app.py load_config(path='config.json') preserving fallback defaults. Write tests in tests/test_migration.py using unittest standard library. Run tests via hermes-crew verify python3 -m unittest discover tests, claim ownership of authored files, and hand off to Reviewer.

title: Review config migration, test parity, and approve deliverables
desc: Run migrate_config.py on real config.ini. Verify app.py produces identical values as before the change (compare against git HEAD/history without git stash, do not modify files you do not own). Approve each deliverable file with hermes-crew board approve <file> '<details>'.
